app.title: ZK-JPEG: Zero-Knowledge Image Editing and Compression
app.author: gslin
app.description: An open-source command‑line tool that applies zero‑knowledge proofs to JPEG images, allowing privacy‑preserving editing and compression.
proposed_tests: Encode a sample JPEG and measure resulting file size and proof generation time
Decode the JPEG with proof verification, compare pixel data to original
Run a batch of 10 images and benchmark average throughput
